rationale.cumulative: A unit allows four retries and 2 GiB gross generation; a project allows 20 GiB and 500000 logical files across sessions and worktrees. Deletion and deduplication never refund these charges.
rationale.git: 1 MiB per newly introduced blob and 50 MiB across the complete commit range trigger review, not automatic source rejection.
rationale.local: 2 GiB covers all registered capture, cache, staging, readback and restoration allocations; cache is limited to 512 MiB within that total. The configurable 256 MiB free-space floor supports small checks without a universal 10 GiB prerequisite.
rationale.migration: Existing-data migration has a separate 500 MiB/10000-file batch allowance and 1 GiB local allowance so over-budget projects can evacuate evidence incrementally without charging new generation.
rationale.occupancy: 10 GiB retained unique originals and 100000 physical objects are a starter profile; immutable packs reduce object overhead. 128 MiB of combined catalog, history, index and ledger metadata prevents split-index bypass.
rationale.packs: 64 MiB targets and 128 MiB pack maximum bound staging and readback peaks; these limits do not cap total migration volume. A separate configurable 128 MiB XZ decoder-memory ceiling covers ordinary dictionaries while rejecting oversized decoder allocations before extraction; original output and TAR metadata limits still apply.
rationale.retention: 30 days uses original sealing time. Drive expiry remains unset until explicitly selected; access and restoration do not reset evidence age.
rationale.run: 250 MiB warns and 500 MiB stops a managed run; synthetic tests include small captures, logs, and aggregate split attempts.
rationale.targets: Manifest and result/capture/scenario sizes are compactness targets; exceeding one requires review and does not permit splitting, truncating, or skipping required observations.
